grammar.pattern: 杯 / 本 / 个 / 家 / 间 / 口 / 块 / 页
grammar.explanation: Use 杯 for cupfuls, 本 for books, 个 for many ordinary objects, 家 for shops/businesses, 间 for rooms, 口 in family-member counts, 块 for yuan or pieces, and 页 for pages. 一杯水 counts the drink; 一个杯子 counts its container. Classifiers are linked to a noun, not chosen by English plural endings.

examples.zh: 两杯水，两本书，三个杯子。
examples.py: liǎng bēi shuǐ , liǎng běn shū , sān gè bēi zi .
examples.en: Two glasses of water, two books, three cups.

examples.zh: 一家商店，两间房，三口人。
examples.py: yī jiā shāng diàn , liǎng jiān fáng , sān kǒu rén .
examples.en: One shop, two rooms, three family members.

examples.py: zhè běn shū shí kuài qián , yī bǎi yè .
examples.en: This book costs ten yuan and has one hundred pages.

commonMistakes.why: Place 口 between the number and 人 when counting family members.

grammar.pattern: person + 有 + object · place + 有 + object
grammar.explanation: 有 means have with a person as subject, and there is/are with a place as subject. A place may include 里/上: 包里有一本书. Negate with 没有, not 不有. For an unknown object in a place, introduce it after 有; to locate a known object, use 在: 我的书在桌子上.

examples.py: wǒ yǒu yī tái diàn nǎo .

examples.zh: 家里有电脑，没有电视机。
examples.py: jiā lǐ yǒu diàn nǎo , méi yǒu diàn shì jī .
examples.en: There is a computer at home, but no television set.

examples.zh: 桌子上有一个杯子，我的书在地上。
examples.py: zhuō zi shàng yǒu yī gè bēi zi , wǒ de shū zài dì shang .
examples.en: There is a cup on the table; my book is on the floor.

commonMistakes.why: Negate possession or existence with 没有.

dialogue.title: Tour of a small home
dialogue.blurb: Original AI-assisted course writing; not adapted from a show or song.
dialogue.purpose: Find where the restroom is and what needs cleaning.

lines.zh: 你家有几口人？
lines.py: nǐ jiā yǒu jǐ kǒu rén ?
lines.en: How many people are in your family?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 三口人。家里有两间房。
lines.py: sān kǒu rén . jiā lǐ yǒu liǎng jiān fáng .
lines.en: Three people. There are two rooms at home.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 这间房有两张床，电脑在哪里？
lines.py: zhè jiān fáng yǒu liǎng zhāng chuáng , diàn nǎo zài nǎ lǐ ?
lines.en: This room has two beds. Where is the computer?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 在桌子上。包里还有一本书。
lines.py: zài zhuō zi shàng . bāo lǐ hái yǒu yī běn shū .
lines.en: On the table. There is also a book in the bag.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 书有多少页？
lines.py: shū yǒu duō shao yè ?
lines.en: How many pages are in the book?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 一百页。你看，地上也有一本。
lines.py: yī bǎi yè . nǐ kàn , dì shang yě yǒu yī běn .
lines.en: One hundred. Look, there is another book on the floor.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 洗手间在楼上吗？
lines.py: xǐ shǒu jiān zài lóu shàng ma ?
lines.en: Is the restroom upstairs?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 对，在楼上。楼下有厨房。
lines.py: duì , zài lóu shàng . lóu xià yǒu chú fáng .
lines.en: Yes, upstairs. There is a kitchen downstairs.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 杯子里边有水吗？
lines.py: bēi zi lǐ bian yǒu shuǐ ma ?
lines.en: Is there water inside the cup?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 没有。杯子不干净，先洗一下。
lines.py: méi yǒu . bēi zi bù gān jìng , xiān xǐ yī xià .
lines.en: No. The cup is not clean. Wash it first.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 这栋楼有电视机吗？
lines.py: zhè dòng lóu yǒu diàn shì jī ma ?
lines.en: Is there a television in this building?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 家里没有电视机，那是电脑。我们在楼下喝水吧。
lines.py: jiā lǐ méi yǒu diàn shì jī , nà shì diàn nǎo . wǒ men zài lóu xià hē shuǐ ba .
lines.en: There is no television here; that is a computer. Let us drink water downstairs.
lines.speaker: b

choices: No, it belongs to the shop

reading.title: Note for a visitor
reading.blurb: Original AI-assisted course writing; not adapted from a show or song.
reading.purpose: Find the useful locations and the household items.

lines.zh: 我们家有三口人，住在这栋楼。
lines.py: wǒ men jiā yǒu sān kǒu rén , zhù zài zhè dòng lóu .
lines.en: There are three people in our family; we live in this building.

lines.zh: 家里有两间房，楼上有床和洗手间。
lines.py: jiā lǐ yǒu liǎng jiān fáng , lóu shàng yǒu chuáng hé xǐ shǒu jiān .
lines.en: There are two rooms at home; upstairs are beds and a restroom.

lines.zh: 楼下有厨房，旁边有一张桌子。
lines.py: lóu xià yǒu chú fáng , páng biān yǒu yī zhāng zhuō zi .
lines.en: Downstairs there is a kitchen with a table next to it.

lines.zh: 桌子上有电脑，没有电视机。
lines.py: zhuō zi shàng yǒu diàn nǎo , méi yǒu diàn shì jī .
lines.en: There is a computer on the table and no television set.

lines.zh: 包里有一本书，书有一百页。
lines.py: bāo lǐ yǒu yī běn shū , shū yǒu yī bǎi yè .
lines.en: There is a book in the bag, with one hundred pages.

lines.zh: 地上还有一本书，请拿到桌子上。
lines.py: dì shang hái yǒu yī běn shū , qǐng ná dào zhuō zi shàng .
lines.en: There is another book on the floor; please put it on the table.

lines.zh: 杯子里边没有水，杯子也不干净。
lines.py: bēi zi lǐ bian méi yǒu shuǐ , bēi zi yě bù gān jìng .
lines.en: There is no water inside the cup, and the cup is not clean.

lines.zh: 先洗手，再洗杯子，准备两杯水。
lines.py: xiān xǐ shǒu , zài xǐ bēi zi , zhǔn bèi liǎng bēi shuǐ .
lines.en: First wash your hands, then wash the cups and prepare two glasses of water.

lines.zh: 家里有电，电脑可以用。
lines.py: jiā lǐ yǒu diàn , diàn nǎo kě yǐ yòng .
lines.en: There is electricity at home, so the computer can be used.

lines.zh: 这栋楼的楼下有一家商店，可以买牛奶。
lines.py: zhè dòng lóu de lóu xià yǒu yī jiā shāng diàn , kě yǐ mǎi niú nǎi .
lines.en: There is a shop downstairs in this building where you can buy milk.
